profile_text.body:
Shopify Inc. is a public company headquartered in Ottawa, trading under the ticker SHOP, with CIK 0001594805. On its own website it describes itself as an all-in-one commerce platform for businesses, offering a free trial and tools to manage every part of a business rather than ecommerce software alone. The site also states that businesses can build or grow fast with AI.

The AI material on the site centers on what Shopify calls Agentic Storefronts. The company says this lets merchants get discovered across AI channels, with shoppers checking out directly in the chat and, in its phrasing, without the merchant lifting a finger.

Beyond the company profile, the record holds no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers for Shopify.
